title: Cycles & Brew Coffee Run & Rave 2027 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Coffee Run & Rave Clark Review: 2026 Field, Times, Weather
meta_description: Cycles & Brew Coffee Run & Rave review: the first edition in Clark in January 2026, a small 21 km field, 20°C at dawn, winning times and the post-race DJ party.
dek: What the first Coffee Run & Rave was like in January 2026: a small, mostly local field at Filinvest Mimosa+ in Clark, a cool dry dawn by Philippine standards, a 1:33 winning half marathon and coffee with a DJ set at the finish.
verdict: Enter if you want a small, relaxed half marathon in Clark with cool January air and a party at the end. The first edition on 25 January 2026 had 151 finishers in the 21 km, so you will run much of it alone, and the median finisher took about 2 hours 20. Clark airport recorded 20°C at 5am, cool for a Philippine race. The 3-hour-30 cut-off for 2027 is longer than the slowest 2026 half-marathon time.

sections.heading: The Course: Inside Clark Freeport
paragraphs: The 2026 race started and finished at Filinvest Mimosa+ Leisure City inside the Clark Freeport Zone, and was the first leg of Cycles & Brew's Brew Run Series, marking the café's tenth year [4,1]. The post-race report called the Clark Freeport course fast but did not describe the route [1]. The organiser's page has a race-maps heading but no route we could read [3], so check the map once it is published for 2027.

sections.heading: The Weather: Cool for the Philippines
paragraphs: Clark International Airport, a few kilometres from Mimosa+, recorded 20°C with a dew point of 17°C and 83% humidity at 5am on 25 January 2026, with a 2-knot breeze [5]. It stayed at 20°C until 7am, rose to 22°C by 8am and reached 24°C at 9am, when humidity had dropped to 61% [5].

That is about as comfortable as a lowland race in the Philippines gets. January is Clark's cool, dry season, and the organiser expects similar conditions for 2027, giving a forecast of 23°C to 24°C and sunrise at 6.25am [3]. Half marathoners on a 5am gun run more than an hour in the dark.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: John Carlo Lugtu won the 2026 half marathon in 1:33:43 and Hazel Mata won the women's race in 1:37:15 chip time, third across the line overall [1,2]. Behind them the field thinned quickly: the second woman finished in 2:03:37, the tenth man in 1:46:20 and the tenth woman in 2:23:39 [2].

Of 151 half-marathon finishers, 115 were men and 36 women; 32 broke two hours, the median time was 2:19:50 and 13 took longer than three hours, the slowest 3:16:38 [2]. The 10 km was won in 35:57 and the 5 km in 19:52 [2]. Top-three age-group places in the half are within reach of a steady club runner.

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: The rave is the point of difference. Five DJs played around the venue after the 2026 race, with specialty coffee and music for finishers [1]. The launch announcement billed it as a finish-line party and offered competitive and fun categories with age-group awards [4].

Entry has become cheaper. In 2026 the Long Black half marathon was listed at PHP 2,199 at the regular rate, the 10 km at PHP 1,999 and the 5 km at PHP 1,299 [6]; the 2027 half marathon is PHP 1,899 [3]. Chip-timed results with gun and chip times for every finisher are on MyRunTime [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want an easy-going half marathon with cool air, a small field and a party at the end, or a first 21 km with a generous 3-hour-30 cut-off [3]. Every 2026 half-marathon finisher came in under that limit [2].
Look elsewhere if you need crowds and a big-city atmosphere: with about 150 half marathoners in 2026, the field spreads out early.

The 2027 race is on Sunday 24 January at the same venue, with the 21 km starting at 5am [3]. Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on a post-race report, the official 2026 results, the organiser's race page, race listings and airport weather records.

faqs.question: How fast was the 2026 Coffee Run & Rave half marathon?
faqs.answer: John Carlo Lugtu won in 1:33:43 and Hazel Mata won the women's race in 1:37:15 chip time. Tenth place was 1:46:20 for men and 2:23:39 for women. The median half-marathon finisher took 2:19:50, and the slowest of the 151 finishers crossed the line in 3:16:38.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at the Coffee Run & Rave?
faqs.answer: Cool by Philippine standards. On race morning in January 2026, Clark airport recorded 20°C with 78% to 83% humidity from 5am to 7am and almost no wind. It warmed to 22°C by 8am and 24°C by 9am. The organiser forecasts 23°C to 24°C for 2027, with sunrise at 6.25am.

faqs.question: How big is the Coffee Run & Rave?
faqs.answer: Small. A post-race report counted over 700 runners at the first edition in 2026, and the official results list 151 finishers in the 21 km, 287 in the 10 km and 166 in the 5 km. Expect a spread-out half marathon where you run long stretches alone.

faqs.question: What happens after the race?
faqs.answer: A rave. At the 2026 race five DJs played around the Filinvest Mimosa+ venue after the finish, and finishers were offered specialty coffee from Cycles & Brew. The race director said the aim was to turn a fun run into a celebration of music, coffee and community.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-02 about the first edition (25 January 2026), on discovery of the 2027 race. Sources read: one post-race report (Punto! Central Luzon, a press release that does not describe the route, aid stations or problems), the full MyRunTime results (finisher counts, median and tenth-place times computed from the result lists), the 2027 organiser page and the pre-race launch article. The 2026 gun times were not published in anything we read, so the 2027 5am gun is quoted. The women's winner's gun time is 1:37:20; the report gives her 1:37:15 chip time. Weather is from Clark International Airport METAR, a few kilometres from the start. No route map, aid-station or road-closure information was found; those sections are omitted. Web search budget ran out during research, so runner blogs and social posts were not checked. No rating.
